text:
maria: FYI CI is failing on the heterogeneous nightly pool (mix of A100 + L40). Warmup step OOMs when loading the kv cache in the first token pass. Seen on 3/5 shards so far.

maria: error log snippet:```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while allocating 256.00 MiB (GPU 1; 46.68 GiB total, 12.12 GiB free)
  at /workspace/runtime/kv_cache.cpp:142 init_kv_cache()
stack: backtrace...
```

samir: do we have the job id and node list? can you paste the full CI link?

maria: job: https://ci.internal/redwood/34218 - nodes: node-ml-12 (A100), node-ml-13 (L40). Warmup tasks pinned 0/1 to the L40 and 1/1 to A100.

ci-bot: [ci] Job 34218 | status: failing | step: warmup | link: https://ci.internal/redwood/34218 | logs attached

aj: @maria quick q: did the run pin driver versions? iirc we rolled driver 535->540 last week, L40 images might still be on 535 which can cause PTX fallbacks and larger memory use.

maria: not explicitly pinned in the job. image is gpu-runtime:latest. can that flip between nodes?

jana: yeah images are the same but host drivers differ. we see host driver skew causing unexpected kernel JIT on some models. can you grab `dmesg | tail` and `nvidia-smi -q` from node-ml-13?

maria: pasted dmesg + nvidia-smi below:```
--- dmesg ---
[ 12.345678] NVRM: GPU 0000:82:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:82:00): 79, PID=8743, Channel=00000002

--- nvidia-smi -q ---
Driver Version : 535.54.03
CUDA Version : 12.2
GPU 00000000: L40
FB Memory Usage : Total 48GiB, Used 36GiB
```

samir: used 36GiB before warmup starts -> looks like other jobs might be resident on that node. is this a shared pool?

maria: yep, hetero-nightly is a shared opportunistic pool. warmup should fit but fragmentation plus JIT could push it over.

aj: plan: 1) rerun job pinned to A100-only to confirm L40 involvement 2) run a targeted job with `--disable-jit` env to see if PTX/JIT spikes memory 3) request a bisect on the last runtime/runtime-lib bump if A100-only is green.

maria: starting A100-only rerun now: `ci retry --job 34218 --nodes node-ml-12`

ops-bot: [infra] Note: node-ml-13 currently has a lingering container from job 34199. reclaim scheduled in 5m.

jana: also please try `export REDWOOD_RUNTIME_FLAGS="--kv-cache-size=small --disable-jit"` for the targeted test. if that passes, we can narrow to kernel/JIT.

maria: kicked both: A100-only rerun queued (job 34219), small-kvcache+disable-jit run queued (job 34220). will attach logs. :eyes:

samir: thanks. if A100-only passes, we should capture `nvprof`/memory traces on L40 repro/failure to show fragmentation vs JIT TL. i'll volunteer to bisect runtime-lib if we need.

maria: quick update: 34219 (A100-only) finished -> warmup succeeded. 34220 (disable-jit) hit warmup but used ~18GiB, succeeded.

aj: that strongly points to driver/host JIT on L40 causing extra allocations. next steps: 1) pin host driver on L40 nodes to 540 where we've validated behavior or 2) add `--disable-jit` as a temporary warmup flag for hetero pool.

jana: ops, can we coordinate a driver roll or cordon the L40 nodes until we standardize host driver?

ops-bot: acknowledged. opening infra ticket INFRA-7623 to audit host driver versions across hetero pools and schedule a controlled rollout.

maria: leaving this thread with logs attached to the ticket. thanks all for quick triage. going to add an e2e test that runs warmup with `--disable-jit` on hetero pool until drivers are aligned. :white_check_mark:
